title: zld link error on with Bevy -Setup Fast Compiles Steps

labels.name: O-MacOS
labels.description: Specific to the MacOS (Apple) desktop operating system

labels.name: C-Startup
labels.description: A crash that occurs when first attempting to run a Bevy app

body:
## Bevy version
bevy = { version = "0.7.0", features = ["dynamic"] }

## Operating system & version
- As specified by Bevy Book [Setup](https://bevyengine.org/learn/book/getting-started/setup/) & config from `Enable Fast Compiles (Optional)`
- MacOS Monterey 12.3.1
```bash
zld -v
@(#)PROGRAM:zld  PROJECT:zld-
BUILD 02:00:39 May 14 2022
configured to support archs: i386 x86_64 x86_64h armv6 armv7 armv7s armv7m armv7k arm64
LTO support using: LLVM version 13.1.6, (clang-1316.0.21.2) (static support for 23, runtime is 28)
TAPI support using: Apple TAPI version 13.1.6 (tapi-1316.0.7.3)
```
Homebrew 3.4.11

## What you did

Follow steps of Bevy Book [Setup](https://bevyengine.org/learn/book/getting-started/setup/) trying to get fast compile to work.

Installed zld with homebrew `brew install michaeleisel/zld/zld`
- Had to setup xcode tools for correct execution using tips from this [node-gyp thread](https://github.com/nodejs/node-gyp/issues/569)

## What you expected to happen

Successfully build and run with dynamic linking for fast development on my mac.

## What actually happened

Failed with `note: clang: error: invalid linker name in argument '-fuse-ld=/opt/homebrew/bin/zld'`
